research_rationale: Complete primary FR pages establish seven explicit inventory components, including the split revocation paragraph and incorporated annexes. Six continuing design components first cease by the immediately effective named revocation in EO11884 section 5 on 1975-10-07. The pure revocation of EO7285 is a completed dispositive act on 1948-11-10 under the frozen TC07 convention, not a continuing current predicate; TC11 prevents automatic revival. The whole-order last cessation is therefore 1975-10-07, while first cessation of the spent revocation component is earlier. EO11649/18USC713 and EO11544/11926 were considered as independent authorities and residual candidates, not silently omitted. Every graphic annex was inspected, no own-term sunset, unfulfilled condition or independent follow-up obligation found. Bounded search receipts distinguish dependent editorial observations and false numeric hits; they do not assert exhaustive archival coverage. Provisional status overlay remains unaccepted and is not human certification.
